Name: Nude Animals SVE (AT and CP)
Author: Nighstealer
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
Change sprite of SVE barn and coop animals: bear, camel, goose into NSFW sprites

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
Need to have both SVE and Alternative Textures mods

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]I have seen [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10500]Nude Animals[/url] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/simezi21?gameId=1303]by simezi21[/url] with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18661]Nude Animals AT Conversion[/url] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/CodenAim?gameId=1303]by CodenAim[/url] . So i ask myself :" What about SVE animals? I don't want to see my girls crawl next to bear, camel and goose", so here we are with :[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]4 Beargirl variants[/color]
2 Camelady variants
2 Goosister variants
[ Why no more camels and geese ? My coloring suck :( ]
[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Make sure to have both  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url] and  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url] (CP version don't need AT) before install[/color]
( For full experience, download  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18661]Nude Animals AT Conversion[/url]  and  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18585]Monster Girls Set AT Conversion[/url] for chicken and duck)
